conduttore.consejo: Contract technical term for anyone who rents the good.

canone.consejo: Regular amount agreed for the lease.

cauzione.consejo: Amount in guarantee of possible damages or non-payments.

disdetta.consejo: Formal notification of voluntary cessation or termination.

texto: Il conduttore versa il canone entro il giorno cinque di ogni mese proceste bonifico bbank. Alla firma deposits a cauzione pari a due mensilità, che sarà restituita alla fine del rapporto dopo la verifica dello stato dell-immobile y il balance integrale delle utenze domestiche. Le spesar condominiali ordinarie sono a carico dell-tenant; gli interventi strutturali restano a carico del proprietario, except danni causati da un uso improprio dei locali. Il contrabto ha una durata di dodici mesi e si rhinnova per un period equivalent se nessuna delle parti comunica formale disdetta con almeno sessanta giorni di anticipación. In case di recesso anticippato per gravi motivi sopravvenuti, il condutore è tenuto a invite una comunicazione skutta racmandata e a rispettare un preavviso inderogabile di tre mesi.

frases.it: Il conduttore versa il canone entro il giorno cinque di ogni mese tramite bonifico bancario.
frases.es: El arrendatario abona la renta antes del día cinco de cada mes mediante transferencia bancaria.
frases.en: The lessee pays the rent before the fifth day of each month by bank transfer.

frases.it: Alla firma deposita una cauzione pari a due mensilità per garantire l'immobile.
frases.es: En el momento de la firma deposita una fianza equivalente a dos mensualidades para garantizar la vivienda.
frases.en: At the time of signature, a bond equivalent to two monthly guarantees is deposited to guarantee housing.

frases.it: Le spese condominiali ordinarie sono a carico dell'inquilino, mentre gli interventi strutturali spettano al proprietario.
frases.es: Los gastos de comunidad ordinarios corren a cargo del inquilino, mientras que las intervenciones estructurales corresponden al propietario.
frases.en: Regular community expenditure is borne by the tenant, while structural interventions are carried out by the owner.

frases.it: Il contratto dura dodici mesi e si rinnova tacitamente se non interviene disdetta con sessanta giorni di anticipo.
frases.es: El contrato dura doce meses y se renueva tácitamente si no media rescisión con sesenta días de antelación.
frases.en: The contract lasts 12 months and is tacitly renewed if it does not mean termination 60 days in advance.

bloques.pregunta: In what time and by what way should the rent be paid monthly according to the initial clause?

opciones.texto: Before day five of each month only by bank transfer
opciones.explicacion: The clause clearly stipulates «entro il giorno cinque [...] tramite bonifico».

opciones.texto: During the last ten days of the current month and in cash to the janitor
opciones.explicacion: The contract prohibits payment by hand and sets the limit on day five.

opciones.texto: With 60 days of justified delay after receipt of the supply invoice
opciones.explicacion: It confuses the notice of termination with the regular obligation of the fee.

bloques.frase: Alla stipula dell'accordo il conduttore deposita una ___ pari a due mensilità.

opciones.explicacion: A deposit of legal guarantee required from the lessee.
Generic term of expenditure that does not define the refundable bond.
Notification of termination of contract incompatible with the act of signature.

bloques.pregunta: Under what specific conditions is the security returned to the lessee at the end of the lease?

opciones.texto: After inspection of the state of the house and verification of the full balance of supplies
opciones.explicacion: The text makes the return conditional on the verification and payment of invoices.

opciones.texto: Immediately as the tenant announces his intention to leave
opciones.explicacion: The refund requires prior checks of the property and the consumption.

opciones.texto: Only if the owner decides to renew the contract for another 12 months
opciones.explicacion: If there is a renewal, the bond remains in security of the current relationship.

bloques.pregunta: Who is responsible for the structural repair work of the building?

opciones.texto: To the owner, unless the damage results from negligent or improper use
opciones.explicacion: The contract allocates the structural works to the lessor with that exception.

opciones.texto: To the tenant unconditionally as part of the current expenses of the estate
opciones.explicacion: The regular costs are from the tenant, but the structural costs are not.

opciones.texto: To the meeting of neighbors in solidarity and regardless of the origin of the damage
opciones.explicacion: The community does not assume any private repairs of the owner's elements.

bloques.pregunta: What formal requirement is required to prevent the automatic extension of the contract?

opciones.texto: Notify the other party of termination at least 60 days in advance
opciones.explicacion: «Se nessuna parte comunica la disdetta con almeno sessanta giorni di anticipo».

opciones.texto: Stop paying the monthly fee for two consecutive periods
opciones.explicacion: The non-payment constitutes a guilty breach, not a regular non-renewal procedure.

opciones.texto: Abandoning the property without prior communication on the last day of the twelfth month
opciones.explicacion: The contract requires a formal mandatory notification with a time-limit.

bloques.pregunta: In the event of early withdrawal for serious reasons, what obligations are imposed on the tenant?

opciones.texto: Submit a formal written notification and respect three months of notice
opciones.explicacion: The text requires formal written communication and 90-day notice.

opciones.texto: Dishousing in 24 hours and giving up bail in writing
opciones.explicacion: The agreed contract law grants and requires an orderly framework of notice.

opciones.texto: To pay immediately all 12 monthly contracts
opciones.explicacion: The three-month notice exempts the remainder of the year from payment if it is serious.
